name: set_meeting_config
title: Set meeting config
description: Update the processing configuration of a meeting (manifest.config) and optionally its scope. Only the keys you pass change; omitted keys keep their current value. `self_name`, `new_scope` and `minutes_model` accept null to clear them. minutes_model overrides text minutes generation only, replacing the whole selection object; it never changes llm_provider or applies the selected model to transcript integration, vision or ASR. Supported minutes adapters are listed in get_server_info.capabilities.minutes_model_providers: Codex App Server, Anthropic API, local Ollama and OpenAI API. The connection must be enabled, at the selected revision, and verified for its declared authentication. The model must be available for text generation in the verified catalog; unknown models and Claude Agent SDK generation are rejected. Parameters are closed per provider and validated against the selected descriptor. max_tokens is a Narumi request limit of 1..32768, never an inferred model capability; known model limits are also enforced. If omitted on token-limited adapters, the effective request limit is min(4096, known model limit), or 4096 as an application limit when unknown. API providers require api_ok, Codex requires subscription_ok or api_ok, and numeric-loopback Ollama may use local_only only with a verified local model. `scope` is the scope selector (default deny: a scoped meeting needs its current scope in the request), `new_scope` is the value to store — changing a meeting's scope therefore requires covering its current scope first, and every scope change is audit-logged with the old and new value. Engine and provider names must be registry names reported by get_server_info. The selected transcription_model / minutes_model / llm_provider / engines are checked against the resulting external_send_policy (local_only → only engines and providers that keep data on this machine; subscription_ok → approved subscription authentication only; api_ok → metered APIs including Claude SDK API-key use) and a conflicting combination is rejected with policy_violation instead of silently falling back. Changing the config does not regenerate anything — call regenerate afterwards (it re-runs exactly the stages whose parameters changed). `request_id` is the client-generated idempotency key. Returns the full effective config and scope. On failure returns an error_envelope (isError=true) with code: not_found (unknown meeting), scope_denied (the request does not cover the meeting's scope), busy (a job is queued / running for the meeting; its manifest cannot be changed underneath it), policy_violation, configuration_conflict (connection revision or expected_config changed), authentication_required, model_unavailable, engine_unavailable (name not registered or runtime unavailable), invalid_argument, internal. transcription_model is a separate nullable API transcription override: omit to retain it, null to restore the saved transcription_engine without changing that engine. Only openai-api with whisper-1 or gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize is supported, using an enabled matching-revision API-key connection, verified timestamp capabilities and api_ok. The shared language must be auto or a real lowercase two-letter ISO 639-1 code; auto omits the API language field. parameters is closed and empty: no prompt, speaker references or Responses API options. Global vocab_hints are not sent to API transcription and remain available to integration. Saving this selection does not send audio. Microphone and system audio are sent separately only during explicitly enabled processing, with possible API charges. Optional full effective config snapshot for compare-and-set saving. If supplied, compare the entire current effective config under the save lock before any mutation; mismatch returns configuration_conflict without overwriting changes. Omission preserves legacy save behavior. The UI supplies this snapshot when saving configuration, including ASR retry cache_epoch updates. minutes_ensemble is a nullable text-only ensemble of two to four stable-ID generators and one explicitly selected synthesizer. Omission retains it, null clears it, and an object replaces the whole ensemble. A non-null minutes_model and non-null minutes_ensemble are mutually exclusive after merging all config changes; mode switches must explicitly clear the previous override. Generator IDs must be unique even when labels/selections differ. Display labels and array order are not sent as prompt instructions and do not cause new external calls. All participant selections and API transcription are validated together against current policy/connections/models/runtime before execution and publication, then each external call is revalidated. API participants require explicit api_ok. Saving alone never generates or sends meeting content.

transcription_engine.description: Registry name: auto | fake | mlx-whisper | faster-whisper (see get_server_info.capabilities.transcription_engines).

llm_provider.description: Registry name: none | fake | claude-agent-sdk | anthropic-api | ollama (see get_server_info.capabilities.llm_providers). none = plain minutes without LLM.

minutes_model.description: Explicit text minutes model selection. Omit to retain; null clears the override and restores legacy llm_provider behavior. Selection replaces the whole object and is validated against the connection revision, official model catalog and resulting external_send_policy.

external_send_policy.description: What may leave this machine. Providers/engines that conflict with it are rejected.

language.description: Shared transcription language. With an API transcription_model, auto omits the API language field; otherwise use a real lowercase two-letter ISO 639-1 code. Existing local behavior is unchanged.

self_name.description: Display name for the microphone speaker (label me). null clears it.

vocab_hints.description: Domain vocabulary passed to local transcription and transcript integration. Initial API transcription sends no vocabulary prompt; these hints still apply to integration. Replaces the current list.

new_scope.description: New affiliation scope of the meeting; null makes it unscoped. Omit to leave unchanged. The request's `scope` selector must cover the meeting's current scope.

transcription_model.description: Explicit API transcription selection. Omit to retain; null restores the saved local transcription_engine. Replaces the whole selection object. Saving does not send audio. Requires api_ok and verified connection/model capabilities.

expected_config.description: Optional full effective config snapshot for compare-and-set saving. If supplied, compare the entire current effective config under the save lock before any mutation; mismatch returns configuration_conflict without overwriting changes. Omission preserves legacy save behavior. The UI supplies this snapshot when saving configuration, including ASR retry cache_epoch updates. This full snapshot includes minutes_ensemble and every participant selection, not only the edited card.

minutes_ensemble.description: Whole-object text ensemble update. Omit to retain, null to clear. Explicitly clear minutes_model when switching to an ensemble; merged simultaneous overrides are rejected. Use full expected_config for compare-and-set saving.

config.description: Full effective config after the update.

scope.description: Effective scope after the update (null = unscoped).
